text:
priya: Heads up — noticed Viewer users seeing the 'Edit project' button in Console after yesterday's role matrix split.
alex: what page? can you repro steps?
priya: steps: 1) sign in as viewer, 2) open /projects/123, 3) observe edit kebab present. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/example-blurred.png
alex: omg. @jordan @rachel assigning.
jordan: looking now. got quick logs — looks like permission checks hit cache miss and fallback applied admin flag.
deploy-bot: deploy notice: rollout v2.3.7 to console-prod started by @rachel at 2024-10-17T09:02Z :rocket: 
rachel: that deploy included the role-split middleware. maybe cache key change.
jordan: reproduce locally with env RBAC_STRATEGY=splitbackoff. attaching snippet:
```
if (!matrix.has(role, action)) {
  // legacy fallback
  return legacyPerms.check(user, action) || {allow: false}
}
```
priya: so legacy fallback is sometimes returning true for viewers? how?
alex: likely because legacyPerms uses group-membership with old tenant mapping; when tenant id is nil it defaults to org-admin group.
rachel: I ran a quick audit: `SELECT count(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE action='show_edit_button' AND role='viewer' AND ts>'2024-10-16'` => 18 events.
jordan: I can push a hotfix to short-circuit fallback for UI gating: remove legacy fallback for UI actions.
priya: we need KMS audit as well — are any of these users accessing KMS-wrapped secrets when edit appears?
rachel: checked KMS logs: no key decrypt operations tied to these events.
alex: priority: P0 on console UI gating bug. triage: rollback? hotfix? canary?
priya: don't rollback console deploy — would impact Dedicated customers. recommend hotfix patch and canary to 5%.
jordan: ok I'll open PR with change and add unit test for nil tenant->no fallback. will also push additional audit log flag `rbac_source=splitbackoff-hotfix`.
ops-monitor: deploy window scheduled 10:30UTC for canary.
priya: leaving note for compliance: please add audit ticket and CCE-2024-402.
rachel: filing ticket now.
alex: thx all. postmortem if not resolved by EOD.
